server_side_pipeline_ms.note: Parsed from the runtime's structured logs (span: infer, infer_latency_ns), which exclude HTTP transport and JSON encoding. The client-observed numbers above are dominated by JSON: an encoded image is sent as a JSON array of ~98k numbers, which costs more than the preprocessing being compared. Use the binary tensor extension to close that gap.

caveats: Postprocessing runs on the CPU in BOTH ensembles: this stack has no GPU postprocess step, so this measures preprocessing placement only, not end-to-end GPU pre+post.
Inference is TensorRT FP16 on GPU in both, and identical between them.

model.note: Engine is TensorRT-version and GPU specific; rebuild before comparing numbers on other hardware.
